title: FPA API v1 job and shared wire contracts (docs 05/64/90, DEC-016/017)
description: Normative documentation attachment, not an implemented API. Money is a decimal string in every schema, in project major units. Sibling arithmetic/ownership checks are specified in doc 64 and independently tested as document oracles. Doc 05 §6 owns health/project/period DTO definitions and the x-project-endpoints catalogue. Root validation remains Job; other DTOs use named definitions. Contextual NFC/ownership/calendar and lifecycle/atomicity checks are runtime obligations, not supplied by this schema. Doc 05 §7 (DEC-018) owns the lifecycle DTOs and endpoint/policy annotations; filesystem/lease/keyring/receipt/baseline guarantees require runtime verification. Doc 05 §8 / doc 30 §6–§7 own DEC-020 close review DTOs and policy metadata. No runtime readiness/financial/lease/audit proof is implied.

Money.description: Money is a decimal string in major units, never a JSON number. Project exponent is fixed at 0/2/3; the API adapter enforces that context.

DecimalString.description: Exact decimal ratio/percentage/driver; not a JSON float.

ArtifactPath.description: Relative path resolved below project/chosen-export root; runtime also resolves symlinks and containment.

ProjectName.description: NFC required by doc 05 §6.0; Unicode normalization/casefold uniqueness are contextual runtime checks.

signer.description: ProjectName syntax/NFC only; signer labels have no uniqueness requirement and are not authenticated identity.

allOf.pattern: ^I confirm the pack for [0-9]{4}-P(0[1-9]|1[0-2]) is complete and reviewed$

signer.description: ProjectName syntax/NFC only; signer labels have no uniqueness requirement and are not authenticated identity.

attestation_text.pattern: ^I reviewed the restatement impact for [0-9]{4}-P(0[1-9]|1[0-2]) and approve these changes$
